_comment: assess.py reads thresholds["coupling"].get("min") (.claude/skills/code-qualities-assessment/scripts/assess.py:1522); a config that leaves coupling.min unset has its coupling gate skipped rather than gated incorrectly (line 1519-1520 comment). This file leaves coupling empty, so no coupling gate fires. assess.py never reads a "warn" field for any quality, only each quality's "min", so the warn keys this file used to carry were inert and are gone; coupling.max was never read either.
